name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor for a basement design?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor for a basement design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your layout consultation, decide on your must-have rooms, such as an extra bedroom, bathroom, wet bar, or home gym. Note any past moisture issues, locate your main cleanouts and water shut-off valves, and measure access points for moving materials downstairs. Gathering reference photos for trim styles, paint colors, and tile preferences also helps. Sharing these details early allows Abraham Becerra to evaluate mechanical clearance around furnaces and main beams during the initial site evaluation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify priority rooms, list any moisture history, locate main utility shut-offs, and collect layout ideas to review during the initial site walk.
